name: Sadaralli Grey Granite
text: A high-density, salt-and-pepper grey granite celebrated for exceptional compressive strength, weather resistance, and timeless architectural uniformity.

name: Viscon White Granite
text: A dramatic white-and-grey granite renowned for dynamic, sweeping charcoal waves and bold marble-like veining across a cool white bedrock.

name: Surf Green Granite
text: A distinctive pastel-green natural stone featuring subtle olive-sage hues, soft linear mineral flow, and warm quartz highlights reminiscent of ocean tides.

name: Chida White Granite
text: Fine-grained architectural white granite characterized by a remarkably uniform, soft grey-white matrix. Favored for minimalist facades, high-traffic commercial flooring, and pristine interior surfaces.

name: Colonial White Granite
text: A luxurious Indian white granite featuring a milky-white and cotton-pale backdrop accented with delicate smoky grey veining and pinpoint dark mineral crystals.

name: Ivory White Granite
text: A soft, soothing cream-toned granite featuring delicate beige undertones, fine golden-brown flecks, and a consistently balanced crystalline texture.

name: Titanium Black Granite
text: An intensely deep, dramatic black granite highlighted with subtle charcoal depth and reflective mineral crystals that create a mirror-like luxury luster.

name: Flash Blue Granite
text: An extraordinary dark stone boasting electrifying ribbons of metallic blue, silver, and copper-bronze running through a deep midnight black bedrock.

name: Imperial White Granite
text: A celebrated south Indian granite with a luminous white-to-frost-grey base accented by subtle pink undertones and distinctive burgundy garnet specks.

name: Moon White Granite
text: A distinctive and refined light granite displaying an intricate matrix of silvery-white, pale ivory, and deep garnet-red crystalline deposits with gentle swirling movement.

name: Astoria Granite
text: A warm, inviting Indian granite showcasing rich cream and golden champagne tones layered with gentle chocolate and caramel linear currents.

name: Sea Green Granite
text: A deep, oceanic green granite enriched with crystalline white veining and undulating emerald textures that deliver a vibrant connection to nature.

name: River White Granite
text: Iconic Indian natural stone distinguished by soft, flowing silver-grey currents and dark crimson garnet crystals meandering across a light translucent white canvas.

name: Silver Grey Quartzite
text: High-durability foliated quartzite-slate delivering shimmering crystalline silver tones with exceptional hardness and natural slip resistance.

name: Indian Autumn Slatestone

name: Black Slatestone

name: Zeera Green Slate
text: Renowned quartzite-slate exhibiting a soothing pale sage-green tone with natural micaceous sparkle and remarkable non-slip properties.

name: Silver Leaf Slate
text: A lustrous slate showcasing natural silver-leaf foliation patterns with a subtle pearlescent sheen that elevates contemporary architecture.

name: Pure Pink Slatestone
text: Distinctive single-hue pink slate offering gentle pastel terracotta-rose tones with a smooth, velvety natural cleft texture.

name: Multi Grey / South Multi Slatestone
text: Rich multi-tonal slate bringing together slate grey, muted ochre, pewter, and charcoal shades in an authentic natural split texture.

name: M. Black Slatestone
text: Dense, calibrated Indian slate with an intense matte-black presence and refined natural cleft texture engineered for precision architectural installation.

name: Multi Pink Slatestone

name: Rustic Green Slatestone

name: M. Green Slatestone
text: Medium-toned earthy green slatestone with calibrated back and consistent splitting plane for effortless architectural tiling.

name: Vijay Gold Slatestone
text: Luminous golden-yellow and warm amber slate imbued with natural mineral richness and subtle shimmer, evocative of sunlit sandstone.

name: Rustic Black Slatestone
text: Charcoal black slatestone infused with authentic copper-bronze and iron-oxide oxidation accents, creating an organic rustic patina.

name: Autumn Rustic Slatestone
text: High-texture rustic slate bearing pronounced earthy ochre, burnt orange, and slate-grey mineral markings with timeless weathered charm.

name: Chocolate Slatestone
text: A rich, cocoa-brown to dark mahogany slate providing deep earthy warmth, excellent density, and distinguished architectural gravitas.

name: Silver Grey Matrix Slate
text: A sophisticated silver-grey slate with fine micaceous sheen and delicate linear matrix layering that reflects light softly in outdoor and indoor spaces.
